article.title: Stefan Homburg on Piketty
article.excerpt: It is a useful overview (pdf, but better link here ) of some of the major problems in the argument, here is one key passage: Piketty’s erroneous claim is due to the implicit assumption that savings are never consumed, nor spent on charitable purposes or used to exert power over others. It is only under this outlandish premise that wealth grows at the rate r.
